verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents bank reconciliation that it markets for 'swift month-end closing', including API endpoints to create and list reconciliations. It also supports accountant collaboration on journal entries and reconciliation, plus an audit trail and trigger workflows that could approximate a review process. However, the evidence shows no month-end close checklist that tracks tasks. Missing for 10: a native close checklist or task tracker, accrual tracking or scheduling, review/sign-off status per close task, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
